name: Kagami Ryuuchi
source:
Kagami Ryuuchi is a ghoul appearing in the video game Tokyo Ghoul: Jail.

Known by his alias Ruchi (ルチ), he is a former top brass of the Black Dobers, and a suspect in the hunt for Jail.

During the time of the feud with the Devil Ape, Ruchi acted as the close aide of Kaya Irimi. He was strongly opposed to Kaya's working for Yoshimura, reconciling with Koma and working at Anteiku, so he, then about 19 years old, left the Black Dobers along with his subordinates. Still holding a sense of respect, he wishes to lead the Black Dobers once more. (By gathering comrades, is he making arrangements so that Kaya can go on a rampage at any time?)

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Rio_(game)#cite_note-Rio_Character_Profile-0]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
